name: Colossus Clash
summary:
Take the fight to the enemy in this VR destruction based fighting game that puts you in the place of a newly arisen Colossus with freedom to protect the world from the other Colossi, or use the buildings and vehicles to your advantage to take down your foe's.
Buildings collapse around you, as you attempt to defeat the enemies that want to take over.
